core_obligations: Choose presentations: take a scheme covering the target and a scheme covering the fibre product of the source with it, chosen so that the images of the relevant points of finite type are the prescribed ones (proof lines 3749-3757)
Scheme-level step: apply the corresponding statement for schemes to the surjective morphism of finite type between the presenting schemes (proof lines 3758-3760)

Conclusion: the point of finite type of the target obtained this way is the image of the given point, by the criterion characterizing points of finite type through the presentation (proof lines 3761-3763)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the image of a point of finite type under a surjective morphism of finite type of algebraic stacks is again a point of finite type (author lemma at source lines 3742-3747, label lemma-finite-type-points-surjective-morphism). The proof (source lines 3749-3764) chooses presentations of the source and target adapted to the given point, applies the corresponding statement for schemes and returns through the characterization of points of finite type by presentations (proof lines 3749-3763). The choice of presentations and the return to the stack-level characterization are the content. H2.
